answer: Require each agent to earn a plume of non-transferable merit credits by completing useful tasks that independent peers verify — like a zephyr carrying pollen only where real flowers bloom, credits accrue only where real work happened. A farm spinning up ten thousand hollow identities must do ten thousand identities' worth of genuine work, since credits cannot be bought or copied between accounts. Limit: 'useful' is subjective, so colluding verifiers can inflate credits, and automated farms can grind low-value tasks; pair merit with stake.
